root_cause_label: Incorrect QEMU disk interface (virtio) for Windows 3.11 image, which requires IDE
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent launched QEMU with `if=virtio` disk interface which Windows 3.11 cannot recognize (requiring IDE), preventing the VM from booting to desktop, and additionally switched nginx to port 8082 instead of the required port 80.
t_err_evidence: nohup qemu-system-i386 -drive file=...,if=virtio ... -serial stdio ... -monitor stdio (misconfigured launch executed)
t_commit_evidence: Step 8: QEMU starts successfully in background with the virtio configuration. The agent never revisits or corrects the disk interface throughout the remaining 138 steps; it only works on nginx and websockify setup, locking in the boot failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge that Windows 3.11 (a pre-PCI-bus OS) cannot use virtio paravirtualized drivers and requires the legacy IDE disk interface (if=ide or default). It applied a modern Linux-oriented QEMU configuration to an OS that predates PCI standards.
